# ---- Constants --------------------------------------------------------------- RULE_MODEL = 'x_gn_purchase_account_rule' F_PARTNER = 'x_partner_id' F_COMPANY = 'x_company_id' F_PRODUCTS = 'x_product_tmpl_ids' F_ACCOUNT = 'x_account_id' F_TAXES = 'x_tax_ids' LINE_TYPE_PRODUCT = 'product' STATE_DRAFT = 'draft' KEY_EXPENSE = 'expense'
rule_model = env[RULE_MODEL]
for line in records: move = line.move_id product = line.product_id
# Guard clauses: draft product lines of purchase documents only if line.display_type != LINE_TYPE_PRODUCT or move.state != STATE_DRAFT or not product: continue if not move.is_purchase_document(include_receipts=True): continue
company = move.company_id template = product.product_tmpl_id.with_company(company) rule = rule_model.search([ (F_COMPANY, '=', company.id), (F_PARTNER, '=', move.commercial_partner_id.id), (F_PRODUCTS, 'in', template.ids), ], limit=1) if not rule: continue
fpos = move.fiscal_position_id # may be empty: map_* then return input unchanged vals = {}
# Expense account: replace only the value Odoo computed automatically target_account = rule[F_ACCOUNT] if target_account: auto_account = fpos.map_account(template.get_product_accounts().get(KEY_EXPENSE)) current_account = line.account_id if current_account != target_account and current_account == auto_account: vals['account_id'] = target_account.id
# Purchase taxes: replace only the taxes Odoo proposed automatically target_taxes = rule[F_TAXES] if target_taxes: product_taxes = env['account.tax'] for tax in template.supplier_taxes_id: if tax.company_id in company.parent_ids: product_taxes = product_taxes | tax auto_taxes = fpos.map_tax(product_taxes) current_ids = set(line.tax_ids.ids) if current_ids != set(target_taxes.ids) and current_ids == set(auto_taxes.ids): vals['tax_ids'] = [(6, 0, target_taxes.ids)]
if vals: line.write(vals)

for line in records: order = line.order_id product = line.product_id

target_taxes = rule[F_TAXES] current_ids = set(line.taxes_id.ids) if current_ids != set(target_taxes.ids) and current_ids == set(auto_taxes.ids): line.write({'taxes_id': [(6, 0, target_taxes.ids)]})

MSG_NOTHING = "La regla «%s» debe indicar una cuenta de gasto, un IVA de compra o ambos." MSG_CONTACT = ("Usa el contacto principal «%s» como proveedor, no una dirección o persona de contacto: " "la regla ya cubre todos sus contactos.") MSG_ACCOUNT = "La cuenta «%s» no pertenece a la compañía «%s»." MSG_TAX = "El impuesto «%s» debe ser de compra y de la compañía «%s»." for rule in records: if not rule[F_ACTIVE]: continue
company = rule[F_COMPANY] partner = rule[F_PARTNER] products = rule[F_PRODUCTS] account = rule[F_ACCOUNT] taxes = rule[F_TAXES]
if not products: raise UserError(MSG_NO_PRODUCTS % rule.display_name) if not account and not taxes: raise UserError(MSG_NOTHING % rule.display_name) if partner.parent_id: raise UserError(MSG_CONTACT % partner.commercial_partner_id.display_name) if account and account.company_id not in company.parent_ids: raise UserError(MSG_ACCOUNT % (account.display_name, company.display_name)) for tax in taxes: if tax.type_tax_use != TAX_USE_PURCHASE or tax.company_id not in company.parent_ids: raise UserError(MSG_TAX % (tax.display_name, company.display_name))
